description: This file contains unit tests for the MessageDispatcher class, verifying that it correctly forwards license requests, license renewals, and key status changes to a media keys client mock, and ensuring it does not forward messages when no client is created or after the client is removed.

classes.name: MessageDispatcherTests
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing MessageDispatcher behavior with mock media keys client.

methods.name: shouldForwardLicenseRequest
methods.description: Tests that MessageDispatcher forwards license request messages to the media keys client mock.

methods.name: shouldForwardLicenseRenewal
methods.description: Tests that MessageDispatcher forwards license renewal messages to the media keys client mock.

methods.name: shouldForwardKeyStatusChange
methods.description: Tests that MessageDispatcher forwards key status change notifications to the media keys client mock.

methods.name: shouldNotForwardMessagesWhenNoClientIsCreated
methods.description: Ensures that no messages are forwarded when no client has been created.

methods.name: shouldNotForwardMessagesWhenClientIsRemoved
methods.description: Ensures that no messages are forwarded after the client has been removed.
